components.description: Familstorm is an engineering studio based in Vietnam pioneering AI-Driven Development. We orchestrate an end-to-end multi-agent AI system governed by deterministic quality gates and human-in-the-loop architecture oversight.

cards.title: Core Human Leadership
cards.body: 2–3 Senior Specialists (System Architect / Principal Engineer, Product & Account Lead) directing strategy and architectural integrity.

cards.title: Human Responsibility

cards.title: Operating Model
cards.body: A lean core directs autonomous agent teams, eliminating the overhead, communication drag, and inconsistency of large manual dev benches.
